key_fields.colony_shape: spherical and various shapes formed when a sphere gets pushed, pulled or twisted

narrative.morphology: large brown to olive-green colonies made of densely packed ovoid cells, floating in shallow water near the lake’s waterline. Colonies can reach diameter >1 cm and are seen with a naked eye. Prokaryotic cells with no individual sheath.
narrative.ecology: Initial development is benthic, but mature colonies float to the surface and are wind-driven to form shoreline accumulations. Masses of this species were seen in Lake Kinneret only once during Summer-fall 2008. At other times, occasionally a few colonies are observed.
